profile.headline: 💻 Front End Web Developer Enhancing User Experiences Using Web Design, Website Analytics, and User Interface Design 💻
profile.summary: My journey into tech started as an electronics technician. I didn't know it then, but it was there where I would begin to hone and develop my skills as a web developer. Being a web developer is more than just knowing how to write code.  Essentially a web developer, just like an electronics technician is a problem solver.  As a technician, my role was to identify and fix the problem. I see being a web developer as no different. As a technician, my tools were power drills, voltage meters, and an assortment of screwdrivers. Now those tools are a text editor HTML, CSS, and Javascript. Once I learned how to build my first website, I realized I found something that gave me the freedom and innovativeness I was looking for in my work. I was instantly hooked and that curiosity then opened a door that could never be shut. Now that I've made the switch to front-end development, I use my organization skills and eye for detail to solve problems as it relates to software and web applications.
